name: ClickSpark-TS-TW
title: Click Spark
blurb: Sparks burst outward from each click on the canvas.
description: Renders sparks/particles that emanate from click positions. Sparks fade out and scale over time. Rendered to canvas for performance. Configurable count, color, size, and easing.
use_when: Interactive feedback for clicks, gamified UI, or celebratory effects.
avoid_when: Rapid-fire clicking without debounce can degrade performance.
a11y: Canvas-only animation; no aria labels. Primarily decorative feedback.
